mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_application (student_id, leave_type, start_time, end_time, duration_days, reason, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{leaveType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationDays}, #{reason}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.real_name AS student_name, u.class_name FROM leave_application a JOIN `user` u ON a.student_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leave_application WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE leave_application SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE leave_application SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND status IN ('PENDING_ADVISOR', 'PENDING_COUNSELOR')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leave_application WHERE status = #{status}
